==Easy==

! style="width:50%;" | Requirements

|1. Cast [[Low Level Alchemy|Low Alchemy]] at the [[Fountain of Rune]].
|
*{{SCP|Magic|21|link=y}}
*Item that can be [[Value|alchemised]] (nearly any item)
|-
|2. Enter the [[Wilderness]] from the [[Ardougne teleport lever|Ardougne]] or [[Edgeville teleport lever|Edgeville]] lever.
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|3. Pray at the [[Chaos Temple (hut)|Chaos Altar]] in the Western [[Wilderness]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|4. Enter the [[Chaos Altar|Chaos Runecrafting temple]].
''Note: Entering it through the [[Tunnel of Chaos]] or [[Guardians of the Rift]] will not count for this task.
|
*Access to the [[Chaos Altar]] ([[chaos talisman]]/[[Chaos tiara|tiara]], [[catalytic talisman]]/[[Catalytic tiara|tiara]], or the [[Abyss]])
|-
|5. Kill a [[Mammoth]] in the [[Wilderness]].
''Note: [[Mammoth]]s are found south-east of [[Ferox Enclave]].
|
*[[Weaponry]]
|-
|6. Kill an [[Earth Warrior]] in the [[Edgeville Dungeon|Wilderness beneath Edgeville]].
|
*{{SCP|Agility|15|link=y}}
*[[Weaponry]]
|-
|7. Restore some [[prayer point]]s at the [[demonic ruins]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|8. Enter the [[King Black Dragon Lair|King Black Dragon's lair]].
''Note: This lair is located beneath the [[Lava Maze]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|9. Collect 5 [[Red spiders' eggs]] from the [[Wilderness]]
''Note: These can be found in the northern part of the [[Edgeville Dungeon]]. You can also bring [[red spiders' eggs|eggs]] into the wilderness, fulfilling the diary by dropping and picking them up five times.''
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|10. Mine some [[Iron ore]] in the [[Wilderness]].
|
*{{SCP|Mining|15|link=y}}
*Any [[pickaxe]]
|-
|11. Have the [[Mage of Zamorak]] teleport you to the [[Abyss]].
''Note: The one-time teleport to the Abyss from Varrock during [[Temple of the Eye]] does not count for this task.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Enter the Abyss]]
|-
|12. Equip any [[team cape]] in the [[Wilderness]].
''Note: Entering the [[Wilderness]] with one already equipped does not count for this task.
|
*Any [[team cape]]

===Rewards===
*[[Wilderness sword 1]]:
**Always slashes [[web]]s successfully
**Identical stats to an [[iron sword]]
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 experience in any skill of at least level 30
*You can now use the [[Lever (Deserted Keep)|Wilderness lever]] to teleport to [[Lever (Edgeville)|Edgeville]], as an alternative to [[Lever (Ardougne)|East Ardougne]]
*[[Lundail]] offers you 40 random [[runes]] for free every day, worth a total average of {{#vardefine:avgrune|{{#expr:({{GEP|Body rune}}+{{GEP|Mind rune}}+{{GEP|Nature rune}}+{{GEP|Chaos rune}}+{{GEP|Law rune}}+{{GEP|Cosmic rune}}+{{GEP|Death rune}})/7}}}}{{NoCoins|{{#var:avgrune}}*40}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
